name: What are common electrical code requirements for bathroom remodels in the East Bay?

mainEntity.name: What are common electrical code requirements for bathroom remodels in the East Bay?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common electrical code requirements for bathroom remodels in the East Bay include the installation of Ground Fault Circuit Interrupter (GFCI) outlets near water sources to prevent electrical shock. Proper ventilation fan wiring is also essential. Lighting fixtures must be rated for damp or wet locations, depending on their proximity to showers or tubs. All wiring must be up to current standards and properly grounded. These codes prioritize safety in moisture-rich environments.
acceptedAnswer.description: Bathroom remodels in the East Bay require GFCI outlets, proper ventilation wiring, and appropriately rated lighting fixtures to meet safety codes.
